purpose: Complete the existing screen's missing post-single-wire-outage conductance calculation; verify numerical optimization against direct grounded solves.
primary_metric_unchanged: original all-pairs mean effective conductance before faults; new outage metrics remain secondary
graph_policy: All eight prior graph definitions and coordinates unchanged; randomized Kruskal seed 20261005; no topology selection or tuning.
physical_policy: Steady ideal DC with original wire cross-section/resistivity fixed after removal. Deleted conductor material lost; no reallocation.
denominator: All 2016 original unordered terminal pairs for every deletion; disconnected pairs contribute zero conductance.
fault_weighting: Exhaust each original edge once; equal deletion weight is descriptive, not a physical failure probability.
comparison_policy: Six identical-terminal layouts compared only within that group. Honeycomb/sunflower remain different-embedding exploratory records.
validation: Every outage compared to independent direct grounded component solves; absolute mean-conductance error <=1e-9; each pair non-increasing conductance within numerical tolerance; exact small-circuit and scale-law tests.
runtime_policy: Three paired passes of full eight-layout outage analysis including baseline solves, graph construction excluded equally; retain each duration and descriptive median ratio. Same machine, no hardware-general speed claim.
stopping_rule: One exhaustive run over fixed eight layouts, correctness tests and three timing passes; no outcome-driven additional geometry search.
limitations: Retrospective continuation of a known synthetic scenario, not a new holdout or independent preregistration.
No frequency, time propagation, signal loss, thermal effects, finite wire/junction geometry, node/correlated failures, healing or reliability probability.
Does not complete 26-family performance championship or validate physical hardware.
